parties: Rameshkumar D Poddar (acquirer) | Siyaram Silk Mills Limited
headline: Rameshkumar D Poddar acquisition in Siyaram Silk Mills disclosed under SEBI takeover norms
sum: Rameshkumar D Poddar has made an acquisition in Siyaram Silk Mills Limited and disclosed it under Regulation 10(6) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, relying on an exemption to disclosure thresholds.
implication: Acquisition relied on a Regulation 10 exemption (likely a non-controlling minority stake or permitted transfer), flagging that not all equity transfers trigger full takeover disclosure-review exemption scope and backstop disclosure obligations.
detail: Rameshkumar D Poddar filed a disclosure with the NSE under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeover) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 10(6), which permits certain acquisitions without triggering the standard 5% open-market disclosure threshold. The filing was submitted on 18 August 2026 and relates to acquisition(s) made in reliance on exemptions provided under Regulation 10 of the SAST Regulations. The specific acquisition value, share count, and exemption basis are not detailed in the headline disclosure; further schedules or follow-up filings would clarify the transaction size and exempt category.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeover) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 10
framework.note: Defines exemptions to mandatory disclosure, including acquisitions by persons acting in concert, creeping acquisitions within thresholds, and specified investor categories-central to determining filing obligations.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeover) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 10(6)
framework.note: Prescribes the form and timing of disclosure reports for acquisitions made under exemptions; requires furnishing copy to stock exchange.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeover) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 4
framework.note: Sets the threshold requiring disclosure (currently 5% of issued capital or voting rights)-the baseline that Regulation 10 exemptions circumvent.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeover) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 3
framework.note: Defines 'person acting in concert'-relevant if the acquisition was structured as a joint activity.
Requires disclosure of shareholding above statutory thresholds (2% for substantial shareholders); coordinates with SEBI disclosure duties.
Prescribes format for related-party / material event disclosures by listed issuers; cross-referenced by takeover notices.
Restricts trading by persons aware of acquisition plans prior to public disclosure; applies to acquirer and advisors.

conditions: Acquisition made in reliance on Regulation 10 exemption (exemption category not specified in disclosure)
approvals: NSE disclosure filing (Regulation 10(6) report submitted 18 Aug 2026)
structure.novel: Filing under an exemption to standard 5% disclosure threshold suggests a structured acquisition (e.g., creeping purchase, concert-party arrangement, or eligible investor transfer) that avoids triggering open-market mandatory offer.

triggers.note: Requires disclosure report to exchange for acquisitions under exemptions; filing itself is the regulatory trigger.
Substantial shareholding disclosure obligations to company and stock exchange if threshold crossed.

firms.note: No law firm names or roles disclosed in the NSE filing headline or Bar & Bench article.
